errors.eventNotFound: That automod event no longer exists.
errors.createExpired: This rule-creation form expired (5 minutes). Run `/automod rule create` again.
errors.invalidName: Rule name must be between 1 and 100 characters.
errors.invalidStoredConfig: This rule's stored configuration is invalid — edit it with `/automod rule edit` to fix it.

rule.created: Created rule **{name}**. It's enabled but starts in dry-run — matches are logged and no action is taken. Turn dry-run off for this rule with `/automod rule dryrun` (guild-wide `/automod dryrun` has to be off as well before anything acts).
rule.dryRunOn: **{name}** is now in dry-run. Matches are logged and no action is taken.
rule.dryRunOff: **{name}** is out of dry-run. Its configured actions now run when it matches.
rule.dryRunOffGuildDryRun: **{name}** is out of dry-run, but guild-wide dry-run is still **on**, so no rule acts yet. Turn it off with `/automod dryrun off` when you're ready.
rule.listEmpty: No automod rules yet. Create one with `/automod rule create`.
rule.deleteConfirmBody: This permanently deletes **{name}**. Its past events stay in the log, but the rule stops evaluating immediately.

pattern.tooLong: Pattern must be {max} characters or fewer.
pattern.badFlag: Unsupported regex flag "{flag}". Allowed flags are g, i, m, s, u.
pattern.unsafe: Pattern is not safe (risk of catastrophic backtracking).

exempt.alreadyPresent: That exemption is already set for this rule.
exempt.notPresent: That exemption isn't set for this rule.

dryrun.enabled: Guild-wide dry-run is now **on**. Rules log matches but take no real action.
dryrun.disabled: Guild-wide dry-run is now **off**. Rules take real action when they match — except any rule still in its own dry-run, which you clear with `/automod rule dryrun`.
